sentence: Krakowski et al. note that AI as a technology resource costs almost nothing to reproduce and that little stands in the way of copying it, so the RBV expects whatever advantage it substitutes for to erode
passage: [Krakowski et al. (2023), p. 1426] "When AI substitutes humans' cognitive capabilities, the RBV expects the advantage that these capabilities provided to erode (Peteraf & Bergen, 2003). This is because, as a technology resource, AI has close to zero marginal reproduction costs and few imitation barriers (Brynjolfsson & McAfee, 2014, p. 31)."

gemini.note: The passage specifies that the advantage erosion applies when AI substitutes for "humans' cognitive capabilities," while the sentence generalizes this to "whatever advantage it substitutes for."
